description: Stay connected, productive, and entertained with the IKALL N7 Pro Wi-Fi Tablet, thoughtfully designed for everyday use and convenience. Powered by a smooth and user-friendly Android 8.0 operating system, this tablet offers an intuitive interface that makes navigation easy for users of all ages. The tablet features a 7-inch display that delivers a comfortable viewing experience while maintaining a compact and lightweight design. Whether you're reading eBooks, attending online classes, browsing the internet, or watching your favorite videos, the screen provides a perfect balance between clarity and portability. Equipped with 2GB RAM and 16GB internal storage, the N7 Pro ensures smooth performance for daily tasks such as web browsing, media playback, and light applications. The storage can also be expanded via microSD card, giving you the flexibility to store more apps, photos, videos, and documents without worry. The device comes with a 3000mAh battery, offering reliable power backup to keep you going throughout the day. It is ideal for long study sessions, entertainment, or casual usage without frequent charging interruptions. With its dual camera setup, you can capture basic photos
